candidates.hypothesis: Under the frozen next-eligible-5-minute execution, economic-cohort deduplication, and next-close settlement contract, the deterministic machine-default REDUCE_RISK action avoids enough post-breach continuation loss to add cost-adjusted value versus leaving the held position unchanged; semantic overrides are excluded.

provenance.baseline_policy: maintain the full held-position exposure through the next regular close
provenance.price_clock: decision-time context followed by the next eligible five-minute open

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The unchanged-exposure prior treats the held position as worth carrying through the next close, while the independently frozen exit-breach state calls for an immediate deterministic exposure reduction.

transmission.expected_direction: An active REDUCE_RISK decision should add cost-adjusted value when the breached position continues adversely into the next regular close.
transmission.catalyst: A pre-existing deterministic exit-rule breach known before the next eligible five-minute execution bar.
transmission.half_life: From the next eligible five-minute open through the next regular-session close.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The rule applies only to already-held positions after an internal exit breach, pays the spread and fixed one-way cost, and can be swamped by reversals; any edge is therefore conditional on continuation after the breach rather than a free-standing public entry signal.
candidates.falsifier: Reject unless there are at least 20 active machine-default actions and at least five in each chronological half; the costed active-action mean and median are positive; each half has positive mean value; the largest ticker is at most 35% of active-action count and at most 40% of positive value; every leave-one-ticker-out total remains positive; and doubling the recorded one-way cost leaves total value positive.

baseline.policy: Do not alter the held-position exposure after the intraday decision; carry the existing position unchanged through the next regular close.
baseline.universe: Effective settled primary intraday ticker-day economic cohorts under aggregation rule v1.

treatment.policy: Apply exactly the recorded machine_default_action from discretionary_intraday_guardrails_v1 at the next eligible five-minute open; only REDUCE_RISK changes exposure, and all semantic action labels are ignored for this attribution.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: The exact held-position notional left unchanged through the same next-close horizon, with identical timestamps, price bars, and fixed transaction-cost assumptions.

execution_envelope.intended_instrument: A reduction of the exact already-held cash equity or ETF; no new instrument or leverage mapping is created.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: The next eligible regular-session five-minute open must exist for the held instrument, with the recorded fixed cost applied.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Recorded five-basis-point one-way reduction cost plus a predeclared double-cost stress; no carry assumption is added.
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; treatment only reduces an existing long position and cannot create a short.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: Treatment is capped by the recorded existing-position reduction fraction and cannot exceed current shares.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Machine state and position notional must be frozen before the next eligible five-minute execution bar; settlement is the next regular close.

candidates.title: Machine-default intraday risk reduction versus no adjustment

prediction.confidence_reason: The explicit 100-effective-cohort reopen count is met under a fixed forward contract, but only 12 immutable decisions actively reduce exposure, so the predeclared power and concentration bars are likely to reject.

candidates.reopen_condition: After this frozen attribution, require at least 20 active machine-default reductions, at least five in each chronological half, and no more than 40% of positive value from one ticker before another promotion review.
candidates.next_machine_action: If outcome-blind D0-D3 and model-diverse verification pass, reserve one observed-only attribution ID, evaluate only the frozen robustness bars, and leave all production behavior unchanged.
